_doc: PINE-HOLLOW-REMASTER PH-A1 (PH-U12): Pine Hollow's new MiniMax Music 3 slots, same format as v3-jobs.json (gen_minimax.py --jobs ph-jobs.json --keys <style>/<slot>). Theme 1 (v3 'pine') is kept as it is. night = calm-night (eerie folklore, lantern-lit forest) with a soft pulse from bar 2 so demucs can lift a tension layer; boss = the Antler King, one take cut into 3 phase intensities by stems.py --set pine-hollow (I the Warden = the take minus drums and most of the bass, II Lanterns Fall = + the bass, III the Last Light = + the drums); dawn = a full dawn piece the reward sting is cut from (its biggest swell into the resolve). BPM / key are requests (MiniMax ignores them); the grid comes from beat-tracking.

piano/night.prompt: Genre: video game soundtrack, dark ambient piano with a slow, soft pulse. BPM: 76. Key: D minor. Instrumental only, no vocals, no choir. Setting: Pine Hollow at night, an eerie folklore forest - lanterns glowing between black pines, fog on the ground, something old watching from the trees; hushed and unsettling, never scary. Arrangement: a sparse, haunting grand-piano melody in the low-middle register with long rests, over a cold string drone and a faint music-box shimmer; a warm upright bass and a soft, steady heartbeat pulse of felt kick, brushed snare and low tom run under the whole piece from the second bar to the end. No fade-out: the last bar is as full as the rest. Production: close felt piano, dark wooden-room reverb.

orchestral/night.prompt: Genre: dark orchestral video game soundtrack, eerie folklore, in the spirit of Ori and the Blind Forest's darker cues. BPM: 76. Key: D minor. Instrumental only, no vocals, no choir. Setting: Pine Hollow at night - lanterns glowing between black pines, fog on the ground, an ancient guardian stirring in the old-growth; hushed and unsettling, never scary. Arrangement: a lonely alto flute and solo viola melody over sul tasto string harmonics and a slow harp ostinato; pizzicato basses and cellos walk underneath, and a soft, steady pulse of frame drum, low toms and muffled timpani runs under the whole piece from the second bar to the end. No fade-out: the last bar is as full as the rest. Production: dark concert-hall reverb.

folk/night.prompt: Genre: dark folk video game soundtrack, eerie folklore, acoustic. BPM: 76. Key: D minor. Instrumental only, no vocals. Setting: Pine Hollow at night - lanterns glowing between black pines, fog on the ground, old tales of the Antler King told by the fire; hushed and unsettling, never scary. Arrangement: a slow, haunting nyckelharpa and low whistle melody over fingerpicked open-tuned guitar and a bowed-psaltery drone; an upright bass and a soft, steady groove of bodhran, frame drum and shaker run under the whole piece from the second bar to the end. No fade-out: the last bar is as full as the rest. Production: intimate wooden-room sound with a dark reverb.

piano/boss.prompt: Genre: video game boss battle music, dark cinematic piano and strings. BPM: 120. Key: D minor. Instrumental only, no vocals, no choir. The fight with the Antler King, an ancient forest guardian gone wrong, in a fog-filled clearing of standing stones and hanging lanterns - relentless, ominous, heroic underneath. Arrangement: a driving, hammered low-piano ostinato and a dark piano melody in octaves, over urgent string stabs; a heavy bass and a powerful, steady groove of taiko, kick, snare and toms runs under the whole piece from the second bar to the end. No fade-out: the last bar is as full as the rest. Production: big, close and punchy, dark hall reverb.

orchestral/boss.prompt: Genre: epic orchestral video game boss battle music, dark folklore. BPM: 120. Key: D minor. Instrumental only, no vocals, no choir. The fight with the Antler King, an ancient forest guardian gone wrong, in a fog-filled clearing of standing stones and hanging lanterns - relentless, ominous, heroic underneath. Arrangement: driving spiccato string ostinatos, a menacing French horn and low brass theme, cello and double-bass runs; a powerful, steady groove of taiko, timpani, bass drum and toms runs under the whole piece from the second bar to the end. No fade-out: the last bar is as full as the rest. Production: big concert-hall sound.

folk/boss.prompt: Genre: dark folk battle video game music, Nordic folklore, driving and acoustic. BPM: 120. Key: D minor. Instrumental only, no vocals. The fight with the Antler King, an ancient forest guardian gone wrong, in a fog-filled clearing of standing stones and hanging lanterns - relentless, ominous, heroic underneath. Arrangement: a fierce hardanger fiddle and nyckelharpa melody over hard-strummed guitars and a droning hurdy-gurdy; an upright bass and a powerful, steady groove of war drums, bodhran, frame drum and stomping kick run under the whole piece from the second bar to the end. No fade-out: the last bar is as full as the rest. Production: raw, close, a wooden-hall reverb.

piano/dawn.prompt: Genre: video game victory and dawn theme, cinematic piano. BPM: 84. Key: D major. Instrumental only, no vocals, no choir. The quest's end: the Antler King is laid to rest and the first light of dawn rises over Pine Hollow, the fog lifting from the pines - relief, warmth, quiet triumph. Arrangement: a gentle grand-piano melody that opens up into warm strings and a cello line, swelling to one radiant, hopeful climax, then ends on a long resolved major chord that rings out. Production: rich close piano, warm hall reverb.

orchestral/dawn.prompt: Genre: warm orchestral video game victory and dawn theme in the spirit of Joe Hisaishi. BPM: 84. Key: D major. Instrumental only, no vocals, no lead choir. The quest's end: the Antler King is laid to rest and the first light of dawn rises over Pine Hollow, the fog lifting from the pines - relief, warmth, quiet triumph. Arrangement: a solo French horn and flute over shimmering strings and harp, swelling to one radiant full-orchestra climax with soft timpani, then ends on a long resolved major chord that rings out. Production: warm concert-hall reverb.

folk/dawn.prompt: Genre: folk video game victory and dawn theme, acoustic and warm. BPM: 84. Key: D major. Instrumental only, no vocals. The quest's end: the Antler King is laid to rest and the first light of dawn rises over Pine Hollow, the fog lifting from the pines - relief, warmth, quiet triumph. Arrangement: a tender fiddle and tin whistle melody over fingerpicked guitar and mandolin, swelling with the whole band and a frame drum to one radiant climax, then ends on a long resolved major chord that rings out. Production: natural wooden-room sound.
